messages:
maria: heads up — staging->prod promo is stuck in CI. deploy-bot hung on cache prefetch step with repeated 504s from cache-service. change window is open but we need a decision fast. logs:
```
ERROR: prefetch failed: GET https://cache-service.internal/v1/objects/sha256:abc... -> 504 Gateway Timeout (x15)
deploy-bot: job=promo-12345 state=waiting stage=prefetch
```
kevin: confirming, saw the same on my run a minute ago. prefetch retries keep failing, artifacts exist in registry but cache fetch is the blocker.
deploy-bot: automated: promotion job promo-12345 triggered by maria at 1717802468. current state: PREFETCH_RETRY (attempt 8/10). waiting 30s backoff.
sam-oncall: looking into backend. cache-service frontends are returning 504 due to hang in the s3 proxy pool. scaling frontends didn't drain the stuck connections. i'm going to restart the proxy pool one node at a time, will post metrics.
jonas: we need a mitigation plan: either pin to last-good image digest and skip cache prefetch, or rollback promo. change window ends in ~20m.
olivia: decision needed — pin+manual promote (with skip-prefetch) or abort and roll back staging promotion? prod cannot remain in limbo during change window.
kevin: we have a manual-promote path. deploy-bot supports `--skip-cache-prefetch` for promotions. tested on staging earlier today (works). if infra agrees, i can kick manual promote to prod with image digest `sha256:abcde12345`.
maria: sounds ok to me if we have rollback ready. can we also ensure smoke e2e after promote and run canary traffic 2% for 30m?
deploy-bot: note: manual-promote requested by kevin. command: `deploy-bot promote --env prod --image-sha sha256:abcde12345 --skip-cache-prefetch --tag manual-skip-prefetch-2026-03-21`
olivia: approve. kevin, please also update release notes and add a short rollback playbook entry: how to revert to previous image if issues show up within first 30m.
kevin: acknowledged. I'll kick the manual promote now, and push release notes entry.
sam-oncall: restarted one proxy node. 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 2% over last 90s. still seeing occasional 504s but under threshold. even if cache recovers, manual path keeps us safe.
kevin: manual promote queued — job promo-12346. monitoring e2e and smoke.
deploy-bot: update: promo-12346 started. stage=upload_artifact -> completed. stage=activation -> in-progress.
deploy-bot: success: promo-12346 completed. prod now running image sha256:abcde12345. tag=manual-skip-prefetch-2026-03-21. label=promoted_manually
maria: excellent. running canary checks and smoke e2e now. watching latency/5xx dashboards for 30m.
olivia: i'll add a release note: "Manual promotion performed due to transient cache prefetch 504s. Promoted image sha256:abcde12345; skipped cache prefetch. Monitoring for 30m. If issues, rollback to previous image sha256:fedcba98765."
kevin: release notes pushed, rollback playbook added to the release doc, and support notified.
sam-oncall: cache-service team opened incident INC-2026-03-cache-17. initial hypothesis: s3 proxy thread leak under burst. will follow up with postmortem.
maria: leaving this thread pinned to the release doc. thanks everyone — closing promo hold. follow-ups: postmortem, add prefetch circuit-breaker fallback, and ensure deploy-bot docs include --skip-cache-prefetch guidance.
olivia: noted for release notes + change window record. closing thread after monitoring window finishes. :white_check_mark:
